commit_message: Renderer: make skinned material shader vertex-only
pr_title: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues the generic renderer PBR/material foundation. Removes the obsolete duplicate fragment/material/light/shadow implementation from `mesh_skinned.wgsl`, leaving skeletal deformation as its sole responsibility. Skinned material pipelines continue to pair this vertex stage with the authoritative `mesh.wgsl` fragment stage.

## Validation

Windows Validation is dispatched by the trusted GameEngine dispatcher. The cumulative PR still changes Cargo.lock, so full workspace validation is expected.
